174:         self.thread_id_g@ == thread_idx
175:     }
176:     invariant on atomic with (flat_combiner_instance, unbounded_log_instance, batch, thread_id_g) specifically (self.atomic.0) is (v: u64, g: ContextGhost<DT>) {
177:         &&& g.inv(v, thread_id_g@, batch.0, flat_combiner_instance@, unbounded_log_instance@)
178:     }

182: impl<DT: Dispatch> Context<DT> {
183:     pub fn new(
184:         thread_id: usize,
185:         slot: Tracked<FlatCombiner::slots>,
186:         flat_combiner_instance: Tracked<FlatCombiner::Instance>,
187:         unbounded_log_instance: Tracked<UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>>,
188:     ) -> (res: (Context<DT>, Tracked<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>))
189:         requires
190:             slot@.value().is_Empty(),
191:             slot@.instance_id() == flat_combiner_instance@.id(),
192:             slot@.key() == thread_id as nat,
193:         ensures
194:             res.0.wf(thread_id as nat),
195:             res.0.batch.0.id() == res.1@@.pcell,
196:             res.0.flat_combiner_instance == flat_combiner_instance,
197:             res.0.unbounded_log_instance == unbounded_log_instance,
198:             res.1@.mem_contents().is_uninit(),

201:         proof {
202:             thread_id_g = thread_id as nat;
203:         }
204:         let (batch, batch_perms) = PCell::empty();
205:         let batch = CachePadded(batch);
206:         let tracked context_ghost = ContextGhost {
207:             batch_perms: None,
208:             slots: slot.get(),
209:             update: Option::None,
210:         };
211:         let atomic = CachePadded(
212:             AtomicU64::new(
213:                 Ghost((flat_combiner_instance, unbounded_log_instance, batch, Ghost(thread_id_g))),
214:                 0,
215:                 Tracked(context_ghost),
216:             ),
217:         );
218:         (
219:             Context {
220:                 batch,
221:                 atomic,
222:                 thread_id_g: Ghost(thread_id_g),
223:                 flat_combiner_instance,
224:                 unbounded_log_instance,
225:             },
226:             batch_perms,
227:         )
228:     }

230:     pub fn enqueue_op(
231:         &self,
232:         op: DT::WriteOperation,
233:         context_ghost: Tracked<FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>>,
234:     ) -> (res: (bool, Tracked<FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>>))
235:         requires
236:             context_ghost@.enqueue_op_pre(
237:                 self.thread_id_g@,
238:                 op,
239:                 self.batch.0.id(),
240:                 self.flat_combiner_instance@,
241:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
242:             ),
243:             self.wf(self.thread_id_g@),
244:         ensures
245:             res.1@.enqueue_op_post(context_ghost@),
246:             res.1@.cell_id == self.batch.0.id(),
247:             self.wf(self.thread_id_g@),
248:     {
249:         let tracked FCClientRequestResponseGhost {
250:             batch_perms: batch_perms,
251:             cell_id,
252:             local_updates: local_updates,
253:             fc_clients: mut fc_clients,
254:         } = context_ghost.get();
255:         let tracked mut batch_perms = batch_perms.tracked_unwrap();
256:         let tracked local_updates = local_updates.tracked_unwrap();
257:         self.batch.0.put(Tracked(&mut batch_perms), PendingOperation::new(op));
258:         let tracked send_request_result;
259:         let res =
260:             atomic_with_ghost!(
261:             &self.atomic.0 => store(1);
262:             update prev->next;
263:             ghost g => {
264:                 let ghost tid = fc_clients.key();
265:                 let ghost rid = local_updates.key();
266: 
267:                 self.flat_combiner_instance.borrow().pre_send_request(tid, &fc_clients, &g.slots);
268:                 send_request_result = self.flat_combiner_instance.borrow().send_request(tid, rid, fc_clients, g.slots);
269:                 fc_clients = send_request_result.0.get();
270: 
271:                 g.slots = send_request_result.1.get();
272:                 g.batch_perms = Some(batch_perms);
273:                 g.update = Some(local_updates);
274: 
275:                 assert(g.inv(1, tid, self.batch.0, self.flat_combiner_instance.view(), self.unbounded_log_instance.view()))
276:             }
277:         );
278:         let tracked new_context_ghost = FCClientRequestResponseGhost {
279:             batch_perms: None,
280:             cell_id,
281:             local_updates: None,
282:             fc_clients,
283:         };
284:         (true, Tracked(new_context_ghost))
285:     }
286: 
287:     pub fn dequeue_response(
288:         &self,
289:         context_ghost: Tracked<FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>>,
290:     ) -> (res: (Option<DT::Response>, Tracked<FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>>))
291:         requires
292:             context_ghost@.dequeue_resp_pre(
293:                 self.batch.0.id(),
294:                 self.thread_id_g@,
295:                 self.flat_combiner_instance@,
296:             ),
297:             self.wf(self.thread_id_g@),
298:         ensures
299:             res.1@.dequeue_resp_post(context_ghost@, res.0, self.unbounded_log_instance@),
300:             self.wf(self.thread_id_g@),
301:     {
302:         let tracked FCClientRequestResponseGhost {
303:             batch_perms: mut batch_perms,
304:             cell_id,
305:             local_updates: mut local_updates,
306:             fc_clients: mut fc_clients,
307:         } = context_ghost.get();
308:         let tracked recv_response_result: (Tracked<FlatCombiner::clients>, Tracked<FlatCombiner::slots>);
309:         let res =
310:             atomic_with_ghost!(
311:             &self.atomic.0 => load();
312:             returning res;
313:             ghost g => {
314:             }
315:         );
316:         if res == 0 {
317:             let tracked mut batch_perms = batch_perms.tracked_unwrap();
318:             let op = self.batch.0.take(Tracked(&mut batch_perms));
319:             let resp = op.resp.unwrap();
320:             let tracked new_context_ghost = FCClientRequestResponseGhost {
321:                 batch_perms: Some(batch_perms),
322:                 cell_id,
323:                 local_updates,
324:                 fc_clients,
325:             };
326:             (Some(resp), Tracked(new_context_ghost))
327:         } else {
328:             let tracked new_context_ghost = FCClientRequestResponseGhost {
329:                 batch_perms,
330:                 cell_id,
331:                 local_updates,
332:                 fc_clients,
333:             };
334:             (None, Tracked(new_context_ghost))
335:         }
336:     }

338:     #[inline(always)]
339:     pub(crate) fn batch_size() -> usize {
340:         1
341:     }

345: struct_with_invariants!{
346: pub tracked struct ContextGhost<DT: Dispatch> {
347:     pub batch_perms: Option<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
348: 
349:     pub slots: FlatCombiner::slots,
350: 
351:     pub update: Option<UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>
352: }
353: 
354: pub open spec fn inv(&self, v: u64, tid: nat, cell: PCell<PendingOperation<DT>>, fc: FlatCombiner::Instance, inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>) -> bool {
355:     predicate {
356:         &&& self.slots.key() == tid
357:         &&& self.slots.instance_id() == fc.id()
358: 
359:         &&& ((v == 0) || (v == 1))
360:         &&& (v == 0 ==> self.slots.value().is_Empty() || self.slots.value().is_Response())
361:         &&& (v == 1 ==> self.slots.value().is_Request() || self.slots.value().is_InProgress())
362: 
363:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Empty() ==> {
364:             &&& self.update.is_none()
365:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
366:         })
367: 
368:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Request() ==> {
369:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
370:             &&& update.value().is_Init()
371:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
372:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
373: 
374:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
375:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
376:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
377:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().op == update.value().get_Init_op()
378:         })
379: 
380:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_InProgress() ==> {
381:             &&& self.update.is_none()
382:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
383:         })
384: 
385:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Response() ==> {
386:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
387:             &&& update.value().is_Done()
388:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
389:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
390: 
391:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
392:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
393:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
394:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().resp matches Some(resp)
395:             &&& resp == update.value().get_Done_ret()
396:         })
397:     }
398: }
399: }

402: pub tracked struct FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT: Dispatch> {
403:     pub tracked batch_perms: Option<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
404:     pub tracked cell_id: Ghost<CellId>,
405:     pub tracked local_updates: Option<UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>,
406:     pub tracked fc_clients: FlatCombiner::clients,
407: }
408: 
409: impl<DT: Dispatch> FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT> {
410:     pub open spec fn enqueue_op_pre(
411:         &self,
412:         tid: nat,
413:         op: DT::WriteOperation,
414:         batch_cell: CellId,
415:         fc_inst: FlatCombiner::Instance,
416:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
417:     ) -> bool {
418:         &&& self.local_updates matches Some(local_updates)
419:         &&& local_updates.instance_id() == inst.id()
420:         &&& local_updates.value().is_Init()
421:         &&& local_updates.value().get_Init_op() == op
422:         &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
423:         &&& batch_perms@.pcell == self.cell_id
424:         &&& self.cell_id == batch_cell
425:         &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_uninit()
426:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == fc_inst.id()
427:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == tid
428:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Idle()
429:     }
430: 
431:     pub open spec fn enqueue_op_post(&self, pre: FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>) -> bool
432:         recommends
433:             pre.local_updates.is_some(),
434:     {
435:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Waiting()
436:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().get_Waiting_0() == pre.local_updates.unwrap().key()
437:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == pre.fc_clients.instance_id()
438:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == pre.fc_clients.key()
439:         &&& self.cell_id == pre.cell_id
440:         &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
441:         &&& self.local_updates.is_none()
442:     }
443: 
444:     pub open spec fn dequeue_resp_pre(
445:         &self,
446:         batch_cell: CellId,
447:         tid: nat,
448:         fc_inst: FlatCombiner::Instance,
449:     ) -> bool {
450:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == tid
451:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == fc_inst.id()
452:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Waiting()
453:         &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
454:         &&& self.local_updates.is_none()
455:         &&& self.cell_id == batch_cell
456:     }
457: 
458:     pub open spec fn dequeue_resp_post(
459:         &self,
460:         pre: FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>,
461:         ret: Option<DT::Response>,
462:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
463:     ) -> bool {
464:         &&& ret matches Some(ret) ==> {
465:             &&& self.cell_id == pre.cell_id
466:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
467:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_uninit()
468:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == self.cell_id
469:             &&& self.local_updates matches Some(local_updates)
470:             &&& local_updates.instance_id() == inst.id()
471:             &&& local_updates.value().is_Done()
472:             &&& local_updates.key() == pre.fc_clients.value().get_Waiting_0()
473:             &&& local_updates.value().get_Done_ret() == ret
474:             &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == pre.fc_clients.instance_id()
475:             &&& self.fc_clients.key() == pre.fc_clients.key()
476:             &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Idle()
477:         }
478:         &&& ret.is_none() ==> {
479:             &&& self == pre
480:         }
481:     }
482: }
483: 
484: }

573: pub open spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
574:     predicate {
575:         &&& 0 < self.num_replicas@ <=  MAX_REPLICAS
576: 
577:         &&& self.local_versions.len() == self.num_replicas
578: 
579:         &&& self.slog.len() == LOG_SIZE
580:         &&& self.slog.len() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.buffer_size()
581:         &&& self.slog.len() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.cell_ids().len()
582:         &&& (forall |i| #![trigger self.slog[i]] 0 <= i < self.slog.len() ==> {
583:             &&& self.slog[i].log_entry.id() == (#[trigger]self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.cell_ids()[i])
584:         })
585: 
586:         &&& (forall |i: nat| i < LOG_SIZE ==> (#[trigger] self.slog[i as int]).wf(i, self.cyclic_buffer_instance@))
587: 
588:         &&& self.unbounded_log_instance@.num_replicas() == self.num_replicas
589:         &&& self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.num_replicas() == self.num_replicas
590:         &&& self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.unbounded_log_instance() == self.unbounded_log_instance
591:     }
592: 
593:     invariant on version_upper_bound with (unbounded_log_instance) specifically (self.version_upper_bound.0) is (v: u64, g: UnboundedLog::version_upper_bound<DT>) {
594:         &&& g.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()
595:         &&& g.value() == v
596:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
597:     }
598: 
599:     invariant on head with (cyclic_buffer_instance) specifically (self.head.0) is (v: u64, g: CyclicBuffer::head<DT>) {
600:         &&& g.instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance@.id()
601:         &&& g.value() == v
602:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
603:     }
604: 
605:     invariant on tail with (cyclic_buffer_instance, unbounded_log_instance) specifically (self.tail.0) is (v: u64, g: (UnboundedLog::tail<DT>, CyclicBuffer::tail<DT>)) {
606:         &&& g.0.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()
607:         &&& g.0.value() == v
608:         &&& g.1.instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance@.id()
609:         &&& g.1.value() == v
610:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
611:     }
612: 
613:     invariant on local_versions with (unbounded_log_instance, cyclic_buffer_instance)
614:         forall |i: int|
615:         where (0 <= i < self.local_versions@.len())
616:         specifically (self.local_versions@[i].0)
617:         is (v: u64, g: (UnboundedLog::local_versions<DT>, CyclicBuffer::local_versions<DT>)) {
618: 
619:         &&& g.0.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()
620:         &&& g.0.key() == i
621:         &&& g.0.value() == v
622:         &&& g.1.instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance@.id()
623:         &&& g.1.key() == i
624:         &&& g.1.value() == v
625:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
626:     }
627: }
628: }

631: impl<DT: Dispatch> NrLog<DT> {
632:     pub fn new(num_replicas: usize, log_size: usize) -> (res: (
633:         Self,
634:         Vec<ReplicaToken>,
635:         Tracked<NrLogTokens<DT>>,
636:     ))
637:         requires
638:             log_size == LOG_SIZE,
639:             0 < num_replicas && num_replicas <= MAX_REPLICAS,
640:         ensures
641:             res.0.wf(),
642:             res.0.unbounded_log_instance@ == res.2@.unbounded_log_instance,
643:             res.0.cyclic_buffer_instance@ == res.2@.cyclic_buffer_instance,
644:             res.1.len() == num_replicas,
645:             forall|i| #![trigger res.1[i]] 0 <= i < num_replicas ==> res.1[i].id_spec() == i,
646:             res.2@.wf(num_replicas as nat),
647:     {
648:         let tracked unbounded_log_instance: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>;
649:         let tracked ul_tail: UnboundedLog::tail<DT>;
650:         let tracked ul_replicas: Map<NodeId, UnboundedLog::replicas<DT>>;
651:         let tracked mut ul_local_versions: Map<NodeId, UnboundedLog::local_versions<DT>>;
652:         let tracked ul_version_upper_bound: UnboundedLog::version_upper_bound<DT>;
653:         let tracked ul_combiner: Map<NodeId, UnboundedLog::combiner<DT>>;
654:         proof {
655:             let tracked (
656:                 Tracked(unbounded_log_instance0),  
657:                 Tracked(ul_log0),  
658:                 Tracked(ul_tail0),  
659:                 Tracked(ul_replicas0),  
660:                 Tracked(ul_local_versions0),  
661:                 Tracked(ul_version_upper_bound0),  
662:                 _,  
663:                 _,  
664:                 Tracked(ul_combiner0),  
665:             ) = UnboundedLog::Instance::initialize(num_replicas as nat);
666:             unbounded_log_instance = unbounded_log_instance0;
667:             ul_tail = ul_tail0;
668:             ul_replicas = ul_replicas0.into_map();
669:             ul_local_versions = ul_local_versions0.into_map();
670:             ul_version_upper_bound = ul_version_upper_bound0;
671:             ul_combiner = ul_combiner0.into_map();
672:         }
673:         let ghost mut logical_log_idx;
674:         proof {
675:             logical_log_idx = -log_size as int;
676:         }
677:         let mut slog_entries: Vec<Option<PCell<Option<ConcreteLogEntry<DT>>>>> = Vec::with_capacity(
678:             log_size,
679:         );
680:         let ghost mut cell_ids: Seq<CellId> = Seq::empty();
681:         let tracked mut contents: Map<LogicalLogIdx, StoredType<DT>> = Map::tracked_empty();
682:         let mut log_idx = 0;
683:         while log_idx < log_size
684:             invariant
685:                 0 <= log_idx <= log_size,
686:                 log_size == LOG_SIZE,
687:                 logical_log_idx == log_idx - log_size,
688:                 -log_size <= logical_log_idx <= 0,
689:                 slog_entries.len() == log_idx,
690:                 cell_ids.len() == log_idx,
691:                 forall|i| 0 <= i < log_idx ==> (#[trigger] slog_entries[i]).is_some(),
692:                 forall|i|
693:                     0 <= i < log_idx ==> #[trigger] cell_ids[i] == (
694:                     #[trigger] slog_entries[i]).unwrap().id(),
695:                 forall|i| -log_size <= i < logical_log_idx <==> #[trigger] contents.contains_key(i),
696:                 forall|i| #[trigger]
697:                     contents.contains_key(i) ==> stored_type_inv(
698:                         contents[i],
699:                         i,
700:                         cell_ids[log_entry_idx(i, log_size as nat) as int],
701:                         unbounded_log_instance,
702:                     ),
703:             decreases log_size - log_idx
704:         {
705:             let (pcell, token) = PCell::new(Option::None);
706:             proof {
707:                 cell_ids = cell_ids.push(pcell.id());
708:             }
709:             slog_entries.push(Option::Some(pcell));
710:             let tracked stored_type = StoredType {
711:                 cell_perms: token.get(),
712:                 log_entry: Option::None,
713:             };
714:             proof {
715:                 contents.tracked_insert(logical_log_idx, stored_type);
716:             }
717:             log_idx = log_idx + 1;
718:             proof {
719:                 logical_log_idx = logical_log_idx + 1;
720:             }
721:         }
722: 
723:         let tracked cyclic_buffer_instance: CyclicBuffer::Instance<DT>;
724:         let tracked cb_head: CyclicBuffer::head<DT>;
725:         let tracked cb_tail: CyclicBuffer::tail<DT>;
726:         let tracked mut cb_local_versions: Map<NodeId, CyclicBuffer::local_versions<DT>>;
727:         let tracked mut cb_alive_bits: Map<LogIdx, CyclicBuffer::alive_bits<DT>>;
728:         let tracked cb_combiners: Map<NodeId, CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT>>;
729:         proof {
730:             let tracked (
731:                 Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance0),  
732:                 Tracked(cb_head0),  
733:                 Tracked(cb_tail0),  
734:                 Tracked(cb_local_versions0),  
735:                 Tracked(cb_alive_bits0),  
736:                 Tracked(cb_combiner0),  
737:             ) = CyclicBuffer::Instance::initialize(
738:                 log_size as nat,
739:                 num_replicas as nat,
740:                 contents,
741:                 cell_ids,
742:                 unbounded_log_instance,
743:                 contents,
744:             );
745:             cyclic_buffer_instance = cyclic_buffer_instance0;
746:             cb_head = cb_head0;
747:             cb_tail = cb_tail0;
748:             cb_local_versions = cb_local_versions0.into_map();
749:             cb_alive_bits = cb_alive_bits0.into_map();
750:             cb_combiners = cb_combiner0.into_map();
751:         }
752:         let mut slog: Vec<BufferEntry<DT>> = Vec::with_capacity(log_size);
753:         let mut log_idx = 0;
754:         while log_idx < log_size
755:             invariant
756:                 0 <= log_idx <= log_size,
757:                 slog_entries.len() == log_size,
758:                 slog.len() == log_idx,
759:                 cell_ids.len() == log_size,
760:                 forall|i|
761:                     #![trigger slog[i]]
762:                     0 <= i < log_idx ==> {
763:                         &&& slog[i].wf(i as nat, cyclic_buffer_instance)
764:                         &&& slog[i].log_entry.id() == (#[trigger] cell_ids[i])
765:                     },
766:                 forall|i| log_idx <= i < log_size ==> cb_alive_bits.contains_key(i),
767:                 forall|i|
768:                     #![trigger cb_alive_bits[i]]
769:                     log_idx <= i < log_size ==> {
770:                         &&& cb_alive_bits[i].key() == i
771:                         &&& cb_alive_bits[i].value() == false
772:                         &&& cb_alive_bits[i].instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance.id()
773:                     },
774:                 forall|i| 0 <= i < log_idx ==> slog_entries.spec_index(i).is_none(),
775:                 forall|i|
776:                     #![trigger slog_entries[i]]
777:                     log_idx <= i < log_size ==> {
778:                         &&& slog_entries[i] matches Some(entry)
779:                         &&& entry.id() == cell_ids[i]
780:                     },
781:             decreases log_size - log_idx
782:         {
783:             let tracked cb_alive_bit;
784:             proof {
785:                 cb_alive_bit = cb_alive_bits.tracked_remove(log_idx as nat);
786:             }
787:             let mut log_entry = Option::None;
788:             slog_entries.set_and_swap(log_idx, &mut log_entry);
789:             assert(log_entry.is_some());
790:             let log_entry = log_entry.unwrap();
791:             let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
792:             let entry = BufferEntry {
793:                 log_entry: log_entry,
794:                 alive: AtomicBool::new(
795:                     Ghost((Ghost(log_idx as nat), cb_inst)),
796:                     false,
797:                     Tracked(cb_alive_bit),
798:                 ),
799:                 cyclic_buffer_idx: Ghost(log_idx as nat),
800:                 cyclic_buffer_instance: Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone()),
801:             };
802:             slog.push(entry);
803:             log_idx = log_idx + 1;
804:         }
805:         let ul_inst = Tracked(unbounded_log_instance.clone());
806:         let version_upper_bound = CachePadded(
807:             AtomicU64::new(Ghost(ul_inst), 0, Tracked(ul_version_upper_bound)),
808:         );
809:         let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
810:         let head = CachePadded(AtomicU64::new(Ghost(cb_inst), 0, Tracked(cb_head)));
811:         let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
812:         let ul_inst = Tracked(unbounded_log_instance.clone());
813:         let tail = CachePadded(
814:             AtomicU64::new(Ghost((cb_inst, ul_inst)), 0, Tracked((ul_tail, cb_tail))),
815:         );
816:         let mut local_versions: Vec<
817:             CachePadded<
818:                 AtomicU64<
819:                     (Tracked<UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>>, Tracked<CyclicBuffer::Instance<DT>>, int),
820:                     (UnboundedLog::local_versions<DT>, CyclicBuffer::local_versions<DT>),
821:                     _,
822:                 >,
823:             >,
824:         > = Vec::with_capacity(num_replicas);
825:         let mut nid = 0;
826:         while nid < num_replicas
827:             invariant
828:                 0 <= nid <= num_replicas,
829:                 local_versions.len() == nid,
830:                 forall|i| nid <= i < num_replicas ==> ul_local_versions.contains_key(i),
831:                 forall|i| nid <= i < num_replicas ==> cb_local_versions.contains_key(i),
832:                 forall|i|
833:                     #![trigger cb_local_versions[i]]
834:                     nid <= i < num_replicas ==> {
835:                         &&& cb_local_versions[i].instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance.id()
836:                         &&& cb_local_versions[i].key() == i
837:                         &&& cb_local_versions[i].value() == 0
838:                     },
839:                 forall|i|
840:                     #![trigger ul_local_versions[i]]
841:                     nid <= i < num_replicas ==> {
842:                         &&& ul_local_versions[i].instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance.id()
843:                         &&& ul_local_versions[i].key() == i
844:                         &&& ul_local_versions[i].value() == 0
845:                     },
846:                 forall|i: int|
847:                     #![trigger local_versions[i]]
848:                     0 <= i < local_versions.len() ==> {
849:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.well_formed()
850:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.constant().0 == unbounded_log_instance
851:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.constant().1 == cyclic_buffer_instance
852:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.constant().2 == i
853:                     },
854:             decreases num_replicas - nid
855:         {
856:             let ghost mut nid_ghost;
857:             let tracked ul_version;
858:             let tracked cb_version;
859:             proof {
860:                 nid_ghost = nid as int;
861:                 ul_version = ul_local_versions.tracked_remove(nid as nat);
862:                 cb_version = cb_local_versions.tracked_remove(nid as nat);
863:             }
864:             let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
865:             let ul_inst = Tracked(unbounded_log_instance.clone());
866:             local_versions.push(
867:                 CachePadded(
868:                     AtomicU64::new(
869:                         Ghost((ul_inst, cb_inst, nid_ghost)),
870:                         0,
871:                         Tracked((ul_version, cb_version)),
872:                     ),
873:                 ),
874:             );
875:             nid = nid + 1;
876:         }
877: 
878:         let mut replica_tokens: Vec<ReplicaToken> = Vec::with_capacity(num_replicas);
879:         let mut idx = 0;
880:         while idx < num_replicas
881:             invariant
882:                 0 <= idx <= num_replicas,
883:                 num_replicas <= MAX_REPLICAS,
884:                 replica_tokens.len() == idx,
885:                 forall|i|
886:                     #![trigger replica_tokens[i]]
887:                     0 <= i < idx ==> replica_tokens[i].id_spec() == i,
888:             decreases num_replicas - idx
889:         {
890:             replica_tokens.push(ReplicaToken::new(idx as ReplicaId));
891:             idx = idx + 1;
892:         }
893:         let ghost mut num_replicas_ghost;
894:         proof { num_replicas_ghost = num_replicas as nat }
895:         ;
896:         let tracked config = NrLogTokens {
897:             num_replicas: num_replicas_ghost,
898:             replicas: ul_replicas,
899:             combiners: ul_combiner,
900:             cb_combiners,
901:             unbounded_log_instance: unbounded_log_instance.clone(),
902:             cyclic_buffer_instance: cyclic_buffer_instance.clone(),
903:         };
904:         let log = NrLog {
905:             slog,
906:             version_upper_bound,
907:             head,
908:             tail,
909:             local_versions,
910:             num_replicas: Ghost(num_replicas as nat),
911:             unbounded_log_instance: Tracked(unbounded_log_instance),
912:             cyclic_buffer_instance: Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance),
913:         };
914:         (log, replica_tokens, Tracked(config))
915:     }

956:     pub(crate) fn get_version_upper_bound(
957:         &self,
958:         local_reads: Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>,
959:     ) -> (ret: (u64, Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>))
960:         requires
961:             self.wf(),
962:             local_reads@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
963:             local_reads@.value().is_Init(),
964:         ensures
965:             ret.1@.value().is_VersionUpperBound(),
966:             ret.1@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_version_upper_bound() == ret.0 as nat,
967:             ret.1@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_op() == local_reads@.value().get_Init_op(),
968:             ret.1@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
969:             ret.1@.key() == local_reads@.key(),
970:     {
971:         let tracked local_reads = local_reads.get();
972:         let ghost rid = local_reads.key();
973:         let tracked new_local_reads_g: UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>;
974:         let res =
975:             atomic_with_ghost!(
976:             &self.version_upper_bound.0 => load();
977:             returning res;
978:             ghost g => {
979:                 new_local_reads_g = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow()
980:                                             .readonly_version_upper_bound(rid, &g, local_reads);
981:             }
982:         );
983:         (res, Tracked(new_local_reads_g))
984:     }

987:         &self,
988:         node_id: ReplicaId,
989:         version_upper_bound: u64,
990:         local_reads: Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>,
991:     ) -> (result: (bool, Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>))
992:         requires
993:             self.wf(),
994:             node_id < self.local_versions.len(),
995:             local_reads@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
996:             local_reads@.value().is_VersionUpperBound(),
997:             local_reads@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_version_upper_bound() == version_upper_bound,
998:         ensures
999:             result.0 ==> result.1@.value().is_ReadyToRead(),
1000:             result.0 ==> result.1@.value().get_ReadyToRead_node_id() == node_id,
1001:             result.0 ==> result.1@.value().get_ReadyToRead_op()
1002:                 == local_reads@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_op(),
1003:             !result.0 ==> result.1 == local_reads,
1004:             result.1@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
1005:             result.1@.key() == local_reads@.key(),
1006:     {
1007:         let rid_g: Ghost<ReqId> = Ghost(local_reads@.key());
1008:         let tracked new_local_reads_g: UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>;
1009:         let local_version = &self.local_versions[node_id as usize].0;
1010:         let res =
1011:             atomic_with_ghost!(
1012:             local_version => load();
1013:             returning res;
1014:             ghost g => {
1015:                 new_local_reads_g = if res >= version_upper_bound {
1016:                     self.unbounded_log_instance
1017:                         .borrow()
1018:                         .readonly_ready_to_read(rid_g.view(), node_id as NodeId, &g.0, local_reads.get())
1019:                 } else {
1020:                     local_reads.get()
1021:                 };
1022:             }
1023:         );
1024:         (res >= version_upper_bound, Tracked(new_local_reads_g))
1025:     }
